description: Holds branch review monthly plan records, linked to branch review header.
business_purpose: Used to track and report branch review monthly plan records for the Sales Planning & Performance area.
record_granularity: One row represents one branch review monthly plan.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the branch review monthly plan.

columns.name: header_id
columns.description: Reference to the branch review header linked to this branch review monthly plan.

columns.name: section_type
columns.description: Section type of the branch review monthly plan.

columns.name: monthly_plan
columns.description: Monthly plan of the branch review monthly plan.

relationships.description: Each branch review monthly plan references one branch review header (header).

business_rules: Columns section_type classify the record; check the distinct values before filtering on them.
Join to Branch Review Header through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
common_queries: Branch Review Monthly Plan by branch review header
Branch Review Monthly Plan count by section type

known_issues: The table appeared empty (estimated 0 rows) when the metadata was last read.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name BranchReviewMonthlyPlan (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use COUNT(DISTINCT Id) when counting branch review monthly plan records; joins can duplicate rows.
To resolve names, join on: header_id = BranchReviewHeader.Id.
